name: Carolina Giraldo Del Valle
headline: Achieving outstanding results in Business Operations | Project management | Process management | Leadership
about:
🔍Words that describe me: ▢Multilingual ▢Motivated ▢Team Player ▢Adaptive ▢Excellent ▢Communicator ▢Lead by example

Who is Carolina?

✒️A passionate and growth-focused leader, who knows how business processes and operations work and how to achieve long-term business success through collaborative leadership, strategic planning, and market research.

💼Throughout my career, I have played a key role in securing and leading high-value projects for the organization, managing internal business operations, driving process mapping and cost reduction, and making effective decisions with executive teams. I am experienced in developing KPIs and implementing industry best practices for consistent operational excellence and process improvement.

💼During my recent and prior positions, I proved instrumental in identifying the status quo and leading change initiatives, implementing business process frameworks, improving internal efficiency, and mentoring team members with an emphasis on innovation and creativity.

🔑Domain Expertise: Business Operations, Project Planning, Program Management, KPIs Development, Process Improvement, Cross-functional Leadership, Information Confidentiality, and Cost Reduction.

Below are some highlights of my career:

✔Led QTC project with 10 work streams.

✔Reduced time to complete projects by 36%.

✔Hired 3 teams of 6 individuals (2 members each).

✔Achieved $1.5 million in cost reduction.

✔Team Leader of 100+ people in the South America region.

✔Led the program from 300K to 2 million.

✒️I can build trustworthy and collaborative relationships with emotional intelligence and enthusiasm for helping others and creating a productive work environment. I am able to continuously sense-check, adapt, and improve operating model together with the executive team. I have strong analytical skills with an aptitude to break down complexity into actionable insights.

🤝While you may come across candidates with similar experience and qualifications, I am confident that my adaptability sets me apart from the crowd. I am always interested in learning about potential career opportunities, so please get in touch with me via LinkedIn messaging or email [carolinagvalle@gmail.com] if you would like to talk about business operations.
